BETWEEN:-
 HEMANT YADAV S/O SHRI SHOBHARAM YADAV, AGED  ABOUT 37 YEARS, OCCUPATION: BUSINESS R/O  SHYAMBAG NIKETAN NEAR HIGHER SECONDARY  SCHOOL TARAGANJ LASHKAR GWALIOR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI HEMANT SINGH RANA - ADVOCATE)
 AND

THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BAHODAPUR DISTRICT GWALIOR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A.P.S. TOMAR - PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for hearing this day, the  following:
 ORDER

This Ninth bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 98 of 2021 registered at Police Station Bahodapur District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 420/34 of IPC.

His first, second and fifth applications for bail were rejected on merits vide orders dated 27.09.2021,
15.02.2022 and 10.10.2023 passed in MCRC Nos.47127/2021, 2957/2022 and 25715/2023 and remaining were dismissed as withdrawn.

As per the case of prosecution, the applicant falsely claimed himself to be serving as officer in the company induced deceased husband of the complainant, Girish Dubey to invest huge money in the company on the assurance of returning the same with handsome profit.

But after 19.09.2019, no money was refunded to the investors and after death of husband of complainant on 27.03.2020,

sentences.text: when complainant demanded the money back, he out-rightly refused the same and did not pick the phone calls of the complainant.
On the said written complaint to Crime Branch, Gwalior FIR was registered by PS Bahodapur under Section 420/34 of IPC against the applicant.
The applicant was arrested on 31.08.2021.
He is in custody ever since.
Learned Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the matter.
He is in custody for two year and five months and out of 23 witnesses, the prosecution could examine only four witnesses.
Learned counsel for the applicant referring to order dated 08.01.2024 passed in MCRC No. 55911/2023 submits that co-accused Pramod Verma has been extended benefit of bail by this Court.
The case of applicant is at better footing.
Pramod Verma was Director of Forever Trading Company, whereas the applicant was merely an agent.
Since Pramod Verma has been extended benefit of bail by this Court, applicant also deserves to be released on bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the application and submits that Pramod Verma was granted bail on altogether different consideration.
There is direct implicating material against the applicant.
This Court on consideration of overall circumstances has rejected fifth bail application submitted by applicant Hemant Yadav on merits.
There is no change in circumstances.
No material witness has been examined since rejection of last application on merits, therefore, the application is meritless.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
The allegation reflected by the statement of witness under Section 161 of CrPC directly implicate the applicant.
The allegations and prosecution material against co-accused Pramod Verma are not identical.
Considering the material available on record against the applicant, his applications for bail were rejected on merits vide orders dated 27.09.2021, 15.02.2022 and 10.10.2023.
No material change in circumstance is made out.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, this Court is not inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant.

Therefore, this 9th application filed under Section 439 of CrPC stands dismissed, however, the Trial Court is expected to expedite the trial and conclude it as early as possible strictly in compliance with the mandate of Section 309 of CrPC.

(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE Vijay Hemant Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134450169/
